    aura — capabilities · v0.20

    What Aura actually does_

    Shipped today, running today. The one item still on the roadmap is marked as such — a promise you can check beats a demo you cannot.

    Shipping

    Reads and raises invoices

    Pulls invoices out of mail or a folder, matches them to clients, writes the entry, keeps the books current.

    Shipping

    Chases the money

    Reminder, then second notice, in your voice, from your address — every send recorded in the ledger.

    Roadmap · Twilio

    Calls the client

    When two emails go unanswered, Aura picks up the phone, negotiates the promise date, transcribes the outcome to the ledger.

    Shipping

    Closes the quarter

    Turns the invoice database into a workbook and a one-page summary, produced by the same agent that chased the debt.

    Shipping

    Schedules the meeting

    Reads the thread, proposes the slot, books it on both calendars.

    Shipping

    Writes the software

    The agent builds its own tools — scripts, workflows, the site you are reading — versioned in git.
